// diagnostic

E0228

A call under `#Policy(writes: .Explicit)` is missing the `&` or `&&` mark its callee's signature implies for a named argument or receiver, or writes a mark the signature doesn't imply.

What

A call under `#Policy(writes: .Explicit)` is missing the `&` or `&&` mark its callee's signature implies for a named argument or receiver, or writes a mark the signature doesn't imply.

Why

Calls are written plain and the signature decides what each one does. The policy asks that every call that changes a named value write `&` before it and every call that takes one write `&&`, so the text shows each write and take; a mark that disagrees with the signature would tell the reader something false.

Fix

Write the mark the quoted signature implies: `&` for a `&` parameter or `&self` method, `&&` for a `&&` parameter or `&&self` method, and no mark for a read.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0228: tests/ui/writes_policy_call_marks.stderr.

Error [jet.CallMarkRequired]: `.push()` changes `items`, so the call writes `&items`
  --> tests/ui/writes_policy_call_marks.jet:4:5
    |
  4 |     items.push(4)
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: `push: fn(&self, &&Int)` changes this input, and `#Policy(writes: .Explicit)` writes every change and take at the call
 Fix: Write `&items`
